title: Credential consumers registry (config/credentials.json)
description: Who reads which credential, from where. Names and relative paths only — never values. Checked by scripts/check-credential-reachability.js (CI) and the profile-migrate phase credentials-reachability (#1891).

scope.description: platform = host env (same for every profile); profile = the profile's own token file (env is an optional host fallback)

host.description: which host env layer must provide env[]: mcp = buildMcpToolEnv (src/browser.js), bridge = engineEnv (src/runner/claude-runner.js) that the MCP bridge forwards, secrets = the boot secret loader (src/secrets.js REQUIRED/OPTIONAL → Secret Manager then host env; stays in memory, never forwarded as env). Required when env[] is non-empty

env.description: canonical names the host must provide

aliases.description: legacy names the consumer still accepts for env[0] (transition period); not required from the host

filesRoot.description: tokens = AGENT_TOKENS_DIR (data-paths.tokensRoot), profile = USERS_DIR; default tokens
